decision.rationale: TXN-008040 is a purchase of 3134 EUR cents at Larkspur Apparel (MER-000015) on card CRD-000241. It posted on 2026-08-28 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, which is 57 days later. That is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000049 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-07 and a total of 31.34 EUR. The dispute was opened 47 days after that date, so the 15-day wait in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The case has no carrier delivery confirmation and the card shows no refund from the merchant. DOC-000050 shows the cardholder emailed the merchant on 2026-09-10 asking about the order and got no reply. Because the wait has passed, nothing shows delivery and the merchant has not resolved the matter, goods-not-received-merchant-evidence calls for proof of delivery from the merchant. This category never approves a provisional credit.

proposed_actions.note: For the order placed on 2026-08-27 for 31.34 EUR, please send the carrier's delivery record. It should show delivery to the cardholder's address and a signature from the cardholder.
